title: Valley Plaza Recreation Center – Replacement of the Existing “Childcare”
text:
Valley Plaza Recreation Center – Replacement of the Existing “Childcare”
  Building Sign with a Proposed “Headstart” Building Sign on the Victory Valley
  Childcare Building Operated by Volunteers of America Los Angeles –
  Categorical Exemption from the Provisions of the California Environmental
  Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to Article 19, Section 15301(g) [New Copy on
  Existing on and off-Premise Signs] of California CEQA Guidelines and Article III,
  Section 1, Class 1(7) of City CEQA Guidelines
